description: Static assertions for helix-cad-ingest — local inbound CAD reader (PDF+DXF) with export requirements, confidence gate, and classification router
test_input: read the exported PDF + DXF pair for a pontoon bracket part and extract dimensions, BOM, and notes

assertions.name: local_parsers_only
assertions.check: skill mandates local parsers ezdxf + PyMuPDF/pdfplumber, offline

assertions.name: pdf_dxf_pair
assertions.check: skill reads a PDF + DXF pair and reconciles them

assertions.name: export_requirements
assertions.check: skill specifies export settings to maximize extraction (version, no-explode, vector PDF)
assertions.regex: R2013|R2018|do NOT.*explode|not.*explode|vector PDF|ASCII DXF|selectable text|Export Requirements

assertions.name: confidence_gate
assertions.check: skill assigns HIGH/MED/LOW confidence and flags missing/conflict, AI never self-certifies

assertions.name: classification_router
assertions.check: skill routes by classification and blocks cloud OCR for MẬT

assertions.name: dxf_entity_harvest
assertions.check: skill harvests layers, text/mtext, dimensions, blocks/attrib, geometry

assertions.name: structured_extract_output
assertions.check: skill emits machine JSON + CEO-readable MD with source pointers

assertions.name: consumer_integration_map
assertions.check: skill routes extract to requirements/RE, fabrication, inspection, and bridge round-trip

assertions.name: stale_titleblock_code
assertions.check: skill handles stale/copy-pasted title-block part codes — filename is reliable key, code_in_dxf is LOW, never auto-fix

assertions.name: ingest_aggregate_authoritative
assertions.check: skill documents the ingest -> aggregate -> authoritative_bom script pipeline
